description.value:
The Ixal are lithe in stature, featuring horns and a toothed beak, using balloons to transport cargo after losing their ability to fly.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Ixals gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, and -2 Wisdom.
  • Size: Ixals are Medium creatures.
  • Type: Ixals are humanoids with the ixal subtype.
  • Base Speed: Ixals have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Ixal begin with Common and Yagudo. They can learn any of the beastmen languages.

Defensive Racial Traits

  • Bond to the Ice: Ixal gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC in forested or icy terrains.
  • Elemental Resistance: Ixal gain resistance 5 against wind damage.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Craftsman: Ixal gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft or Profession checks.
  • Craftsman Knowledge: Ixal gain Knowledge (technology) and Knowledge (engineering) as class skills.
  • Sky Enthusiasts: Ixal gain Pilot as a class skill.

Magical Racial Traits

  • Elemental Affinity: Ixal are treated as 1 level higher when casting spells with the wind descriptor.
  • Elemental Summoner: Increase the duration of summon spells for a chosen elemental subtype by 2 rounds.
  • Weather Savvy: Ixal can spend a full-round action to accurately predict the weather 24 hours in advance.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Claws: Ixal receive two claw attacks dealing 1d4 points of damage.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Low-Light Vision: Ixal have low-light vision allowing them to see twice as far as humes in dim light.
